title: H is for HOLDING PATTERN ✈️Master IFR Waiting Rooms | MSFS 2024
description:
Master the Holding Pattern in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024—the essential IFR "waiting room in the sky." In this MSFS tutorial, we break down exactly how to fly a standard racetrack pattern and manage ATC delays like a professional pilot.

Whether you are navigating a Cessna 172 or a Boeing 787, understanding holding entries (Direct, Parallel, and Teardrop) is critical for Instrument Flight Rules (IFR). We demonstrate the Garmin G1000 "Hold" function, explaining how to set your inbound course, 1-minute legs, and Standard Rate Turns. We also dive into the G1000 SUSP (Suspend) mode and how to properly exit the hold at the Holding Fix (DOVMU) to resume your flight plan to Rotterdam (EHRD).

🕒 Chapters
0:00 - Introduction: H is for Holding Pattern
0:18 - Why do we hold? (Traffic, Weather, Emergencies)
1:10 - Identify them on the map
3:35 - The 3 Entry Types: Direct, Parallel, Teardrop
4:05 - G1000 Setup: Programming the Hold
9:40 - Wrap-up: Next is I for ILS!
